## What

Briefly, what does this change and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or real user data in the diff
- [ ] Any new environment variable is documented in both `.env.example` and `README.md`
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in `src/lib/openapi.ts`

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything worth flagging: a decision with more than one defensible answer, a
follow-up you deliberately left out, or an area you would like a closer look at.
